title: VR Fighter
description: After his wife's death, professional bodyguard Long Wei goes overseas to find doctors for his daughter, but instead he finds a new job as a virtual reality tester.

title: Militant Eagle
description: A re-creation of high-kicking martial-arts acts from the Oriental past.

title: Kill-Fist
description: A man on the verge of losing custody of his daughter signs up for an underground fighting game to get some money.

title: Ip Man
description: The life story of Yip Man, the first person to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun.

title: The Fearless Hyena
description: An old master's grandson learns the style called emotional kung fu.

title: Fearless Hyena II
description: A member (Jackie Chan) of the Yin-Yang clan fights a Ching dynasty gang known as Heaven and Earth.

title: One-Armed Swordman vs. Nine Killers
description: A one-armed savior battles the local goons and has some surprising moves up his sleeve.

title: Kung Fu Wonder Child
description: A young woman with impressive fighting skills tracks down the evil sorcerer who killed her grandfather.

title: Shin Ultraman
description: After the accidental death of a human during battle, Ultraman takes on the man's appearance and place at the S-Class Species Suppression Protocol to protect Earth from further threats.

title: Yuzo: The Biggest Battle in Tokyo
description: Yuzo Ooki is unexpectedly fired; managing to find a new job, Yuzo navigates the maze of crazy coworkers; Yuzo is undaunted, but he is bullied by his new workmates and dumped by his girlfriend.

title: Blood on the Stars
description: Shadrach and his school choir do their best to ensure local celebrities don't make it to the stage.

title: Housebound
description: A would-be thief (Morgana O'Reilly) is remanded to the custody of her estranged mother (Rima Te Wiata), who turns out to be correct in her assertion that evil spirits are afoot in their family domicile.

title: Curse of the Demon
description: In England a U.S. psychologist (Dana Andrews) seeks to return a doctor's (Niall MacGinnis) ancient death-curse scripted on parchment.

title: Beyond Darkness
description: A genteel country estate becomes the site of a holy war between two clerics and a coven of long-dead witches.

title: November
description: In 19th-century Estonia, Liina may be forced to marry a repulsive farmer and give up her love for Hans.

title: Hell Night
description: Fraternity and sorority pledges ignore rumors and spend the night in a mansion haunted by victims of a family massacre.

title: Patrick
description: Patrick has been in an irreversible coma for the past several years and possesses psychokinetic powers. He ends up falling in love with his new nurse, Kathy, who shows him some affection.

title: Venus Die-Trap
description: On the tranquil coastal plains of North Carolina, a meteor crash triggers a chain of events. As chaos descends upon the unsuspecting town, a determined botany student and a skeptical rookie deputy must unite.

title: The City of the Dead
description: A professor (Christopher Lee) sends a coed to a Massachusetts village where he and a witch (Patricia Jessel) lead the living dead.

title: White Sun of the Desert
description: Sukhov, a Red Army soldier fighting in Asia during the Russian Civil War, is chosen to guard a guerilla leader's harem.

title: Overheard 2
description: A stockbroker for a crime syndicate is hurt in an accident while evading a surveillance operative.

title: Extraordinary Mission
description: Police officer Lin Kai receives an assignment to infiltrate a drug cartel called Twin Eagles. His operation starts to spiral out of control when he slowly but unwillingly becomes an addict while trying to gain the leader's trust.

title: The Minion
description: A holy man (Dolph Lundgren) and an archaeologist (Francoise Robertson) seek a key that will stop a demon from releasing the Antichrist.

title: Convoy
description: Rebel trucker "Rubber Duck" (Kris Kristofferson) blocks a crooked sheriff (Ernest Borgnine) with a CB-linked army of big rigs.

title: Knightriders
description: George Romero's unusual story of a modern-day Renaissance troupe whose participants follow a medieval code of honor.

title: Robowar
description: A team of commandos heads into the jungles of Venezuela on a highly classified mission and encounters a robotic killing machine.

title: Samurai Cop 2: Deadly Vengeance
description: A detective (Mark Frazer) and his long-estranged partner (Matt Hannon) team up to investigate a series of assassinations.

title: Hard Hunted
description: Secret agents Donna (Dona Speir) and Nicole (Roberta Vasquez) track an atomic-related jade Buddha from Arizona to Hawaii.

title: Sabotage
description: A bodyguard uses his Navy commando training to track the killers of an arms dealer he was hired to protect.

title: The Grindhouse
description:
S01 E05 — Lady frankenstein
Lady Frankenstein is a typical exploitation sex & horror flick from the early 1970s; for the most part, it has one distinguishing quality that elevates it from the usual dross: its leading lady, Rosalba Neri.

title: The Toxic Avenger Part III: The Last Temptation of Toxie
description: Tromaville's mutated superhero unwittingly becomes Satan's employee when he takes a job at a sinister megacorporation.

description: A surgeon (Jason Evers) tapes his fiancée's (Virginia Leith) mouth shut and prepares to put her head on a model's (Adele Lamont) body.

title: Burst City
description: Punk bands protest a nuclear power plant and are attacked by yakuza thugs until a pair of metal-clad bikers arrives.

title: The Final Countdown
description: A time warp takes the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz and its captain (Kirk Douglas) back to Pearl Harbor, Dec. 6, 1941.

title: In the Moscow Slums
description: Moscow, 1902. Konstantin Stanislavsky turns to Vladimir Gilyarovsky to search the underworld for inspiration for a new play. Together they find themselves embroiled in the murder of an Indian Sikh.

title: The Golden Fern
description: A wood cutter finds a golden fern that transforms into a beautiful young woman, but fate conspires to part them.

title: Karmalink
description: In near-future Phnom Penh, Cambodia, a teen boy and a street-smart girl work to untangle the mystery of the boy's dreams of his past life. However, what begins as a playful treasure hunt leads to the possibility of digital enlightenment.
